labels.unrelated_prompts: realistic Claude Code prompts whose task does not depend on any of the 44 stored decisions; written before any run, some deliberately share an everyday word with a stored subject (timeout, error, format, message, logging, cache) because real prompts do
labels.related_prompts: realistic task prompts whose correct execution depends on exactly one stored decision (subject); phrased as tasks, not as the stale_exposure questions
labels.unrelated_tools: PreToolUse payloads (Edit/Write/Bash) for changes that do not depend on any stored decision
labels.related_tools: PreToolUse payloads for changes that depend on exactly one stored decision (subject)
